subject: [PATCH v3 02/14] NFSD: validate transport name in listener_set before serv creation

2026-08-28.patch_summary: This patch validates the transport name in the listener_set function before server creation to prevent arbitrary names from reaching svc_xprt_create_from_sa(). The validation checks if the name matches one of the supported transport classes (tcp, udp, or rdma) and rejects any unsupported names. This narrows the scope of a TASK_KILLABLE usermode helper upcall that can be triggered under nfsd_mutex. The patch also ensures that NFSD accepts 'rdma' without condition, even if svcrdma is not built, to allow for modular autoload in the kernel.
